6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Rehauled all of Molten Core to be more performance-friendly, as well as to improve on/fix bugs for some encounters.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Implemented a safer, more performance-friendly anti feign-res counter for dungeons and raids.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Bosses in Molten Core now keep players from entering the instance while they are in combat (boss state).

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed an issue where Majordomo's adds had a low chance to drop a TON of epics.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Made Onyxia's adds use a more secure threat proccing system (and less wonky [my addition COULD have been wonky])

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed issue where Onyxia's invisible trigger one would attack you throughout the fight and it would look clunky.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed a severe lack of purple ghosts in Dire Maul: West and made them all move around.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed an issue where you could not use the item to complete the Onyxia Horde attunement quests (in emberstrife's den, it was an issue caused by emberstrife's den not actually putting you in emberstrife's den)

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed an issue where the Sons of Flames would cast their fire shield out of combat, causing them to spam it when they reset.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Changed respawn timers of all creatures in Molten Core so that they do not respawn more than once in the same run.

5.author: kikevin3000
